label: Finnish residential transfer tax
field.name: Name
kind.broker: Existing housing-company shares through an agent
kind.private: Existing housing-company shares without an agent
field.deedDate: Date the purchase agreement was signed
field.ownershipDate: Date ownership of the new home transfers
field.purchasePrice: Total purchase price before housing-company debt
field.companyDebt: Housing-company debt allocated to the unit
field.buyerShare: Taxable buyer’s share of the whole purchase
help.scope: Use for a Finnish residential agreement signed from 2024 onwards. Update the dates and amounts when the purchase changes. Add one expense per taxpayer when calculating separate shares.
help.payment: Leave blank to use signing for real estate and the statutory deadline for other non-brokered or new-build purchases. Real-estate tax is due before the title application.
help.purchase: Enter the nominal taxable consideration in euros. Enter housing-company debt separately.
help.companyDebt: Add the full amount attributable to the unit even if it is repaid over time.
invalid.name: Enter a name of 1 to 80 characters.
invalid.kind: Choose a supported Finnish home purchase.
invalid.deed: Enter an agreement date on or after January 1, 2024.
invalid.ownership: Enter the new home ownership date on or after the agreement.
invalid.payment: Enter a payment date within the applicable deadline.
invalid.amount: Enter a positive consideration, applicable housing-company debt and buyer’s share.
